name: 30620-textonly-qwen35-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B. Ungated, ~8 GB, downloads once on first launch.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Dense hybrid decoder, 32 layers in a 3:1 mix of linear-attention (gated delta net) and full-attention layers; hidden 2560, 16 query / 4 KV heads at head_dim 256; bf16, no quantization.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 4 streams, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 400 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, plain text prompts, no shared prefix. Prompt length ~920 tokens (stdev 60, clamped [819, 1024]), generation ~256 tokens (stdev 64, clamped [128, 512]); temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so decoding is greedy and runs a fixed number of steps.
purpose: A 4-billion-parameter text assistant drafting short replies from page-long prompts for four concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving a 4B Qwen3.5 checkpoint, driven closed loop with four streams of ~920-token
# text prompts asking for ~256 tokens back.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
tp-size: 1
# Pinned rather than left to the auto-fit, so the KV pool size is a property of the declaration
# and not of whatever else happens to be reserved on the card.
max-total-tokens: 262144
